question: Among the raw pain points harvested by startup-idea-hunter-skill, which opportunity clusters survive the Xiaoming Trap filter to form the top 3 evidence-backed product concepts, and which single product direction should we validate first with a concrete 3-phase MVP plan?
trigger: Having a CSV or JSON table of raw pain points from startup-idea-hunter-skill (such as ideas_27_Oct.csv) and needing to pick the best direction to build
Screening candidate startup or micro-SaaS ideas against the Easy-Vibe Xiaoming Trap, 5-tier alternative solution matrix, and need tiers
Reframing ordinary feature ideas into high-willingness-to-pay product concepts via horizontal segmentation, vertical emotion timelines, and 3-phase MVP planning
decision: Commit to 1 primary verifiable product direction (COMMIT_AND_VALIDATE) backed by a 3-phase MVP plan, bottom-up TAM, and 20-item checklist
Retain 2 backup evidence-backed product concepts (KEEP_AS_BACKUP_CONCEPT), narrow broad segments (REFINE_NICHE_SEGMENT), and discard Xiaoming Trap or desire/vitamin ideas (DROP_XIAOMING_TRAP)
evidence: Hunter CSV export (STT, verbatim quote, persona context & Input->Output AI mapping, source URL, date, Easy-Vibe note) or Hunter JSON clue datasets
Multi-channel behavioral signals showing users already paying freelancers, fighting clunky incumbents, or stitching manual spreadsheets
Horizontal sub-segment comparisons and vertical daily context/emotion timelines (fear, anxiety, helplessness, loneliness, anger, regret)
success_measure: Clusters raw clues into distinct opportunities, scores each across the 4 Easy-Vibe screening gates (5-Criteria + Need Tier, Xiaoming Trap Audit, 5-Tier Alternative Matrix, Horizontal & Founder-Fit Score), produces 3 evidence-backed reframed product concepts, and generates a complete verifiable MVP dossier (One-Person-One-Job-One-Entry positioning, 3-phase roadmap, 3 solo-founder concern mitigations, bottom-up TAM, 6-moat selection, 5-round AI dialogue prompts, and 20-item Appendix F checklist)
outcome: Deliver a structured JSON and Markdown Easy-Vibe Idea Screening & Value Reframing Dossier containing 3 evidence-backed product concepts and 1 verifiable MVP direction
input_types: CSV clue export from startup-idea-hunter-skill (e.g. ideas_27_Oct.csv)
JSON clue or scorecard file from startup-idea-hunter-skill
Raw pain point list with quotes, contexts, and current workarounds
output_artifacts: Structured JSON screening dossier with clustered opportunities, top 3 product concepts, and 1 verifiable MVP plan
Comprehensive Markdown report with Horizontal Segmentation, Vertical Emotion Timelines, Value Reframing tables, 3-Phase MVP Roadmap, and 20-Item Demand Checklist
use_cases: Direct ingestion and clustering of Hunter CSV/JSON pain-point tables into deduplicated opportunity clusters
Xiaoming Trap auditing (incumbent sufficiency, behavioral friction, free substitution) and 5-tier alternative solution scoring
Horizontal user segmentation, vertical context/emotion timeline mapping, and value reframing into 3 evidence-backed product concepts
3-phase MVP roadmap generation, solo-founder concern mitigation, bottom-up TAM sizing, 6-moat analysis, and 20-item demand verification
